However, the rule says Ridge Spur 'may be used only when' the checks pass. That licenses Ridge in C but does not select it over the still-described usable Quarry Loop, so the C target is not uniquely entailed.

factual_and_arithmetic_correctness.reason: The reserve calculation, bridge comparisons, gauge comparison, and unchanged distractor facts are correct.

minimal_coherent_reversal.reason: The sole literal change is the current bridge posting at message 5; no downstream repair is needed because the route is intentionally unstated.

exact_downstream_repair.reason: The actual differing indices are exactly [5], matching the allowlist, and the unchanged assistant response remains true in both variants.

nonfocal_independence.reason: Channel 3 follows western creek sector under a byte-identical mapping explicitly independent of access road.

retained_tail_neutrality_and_coherence.reason: The retained photography, timing, and stop-work exchange is byte-identical, coherent under either route, and does not name or imply a route or radio target.

carrier_compatibility.reason: Replace 'resolved one local decision' with wording that permits a decision to remain derivable but unstated.

The stabilized spread is 88.7 - 86.2 = 2.5. The explicit all-pass-Release/otherwise-Hold rule therefore uniquely yields Release versus Hold.

factual_and_arithmetic_correctness.reason: The mean, signed corrections, uncertainty endpoints, inclusive guardrail checks, and oven spread are all correct.

minimal_coherent_reversal.reason: Only the current signed correction changes at message 5. It is sufficient to reverse two thickness checks while leaving the oven check and all other facts intact.

exact_downstream_repair.reason: The actual differing indices are exactly [5], matching the allowlist; all unchanged responses avoid prematurely computing or naming the disposition.

nonfocal_independence.reason: Cabinet 2 follows odd-numbered K-27 under a byte-identical lot-number map explicitly independent of disposition.

retained_tail_neutrality_and_coherence.reason: Messages 11 onward are byte-identical and omit both room targets and the interpreter time while remaining coherent.

case_reviews.title: Low Tide at Cortes flagged-passage queue gate and production handoff

derivation.reason: The W history says only that passage three contains the full name Marta Coelho; it never states in literal text that this person is living and private, which the gate requires. In addition, the gate says satisfying both conditions makes a manuscript eligible for fast-track, not that fast-track is necessarily assigned. Because no queue is explicitly stated, the intended standard-versus-fast-track targets are not uniquely derivable.

factual_and_arithmetic_correctness.reason: The count of exactly three satisfies the at-most-three condition, but the load-bearing living/private classification exists only in packet metadata, not the history supplied to the probe. The wording that passages one and two are both on the remaining flagged list yet 'cleared' is also ambiguous about whether they remain flagged, although either interpretation stays at or below three.

minimal_coherent_reversal.reason: A one-message redacted/unredacted contrast is structurally minimal, but it must explicitly reverse the full predicate 'names a living private individual by full name,' not merely redaction status.

exact_downstream_repair.reason: The actual differing indices are exactly [5], matching the allowlist, and the unchanged assistant response does not state a queue.

nonfocal_independence.reason: Meridian Audio is byte-identical, separately settled, and explicitly independent of the review queue.

retained_tail_neutrality_and_coherence.reason: The retained procedures are otherwise coherent and byte-identical, but message 11 calls the deliberately unstated focal result a 'settled legal-review outcome,' crossing the resolution-status boundary.

target_leakage_after_boundary.reason: No direction or queue name leaks, but message 11 and the common carrier both leak that the unresolved-at-probe focal decision is supposedly already settled.

carrier_compatibility.reason: The carrier's 'resolved one local decision' statement conflicts with message 6's deliberate refusal to apply or state a queue before the probe.

probe_and_target_identification.reason: The probe asks which queue applies, but literal eligibility does not require assignment and the W history omits the living/private predicate needed to trigger standard queue.

case_reviews.required_revision: Rewrite message 5 so both variants explicitly identify the subject as a living private individual while reversing only whether the full name remains; make passing the gate select fast-track; clarify whether the three passages remain flagged; replace the settled-outcome tail phrase and use an unresolved-compatible carrier.

paired_review_overall.reason: Only e02 passes every target-aware criterion. e01 and e05 need necessary-versus-sufficient gate wording repaired; e03 needs a unique pass-branch route and an unresolved-compatible carrier; e04 needs only the carrier claim repaired; e06 lacks a literal load-bearing predicate, has an eligibility-versus-assignment gap, and crosses the resolution-status boundary.

domain_diversity.reason: The six domains are substantively distinct: software release operations, meal-delivery allocation, field logistics, manufacturing qualification, event accessibility, and publishing legal review.

rule_form_diversity.reason: There is useful variation in sequential screening, arithmetic margin, calibrated interval, ceiling-based capacity, and count/content checks. However, e01, e03, e05, and e06 all use the same binary special-path-if-gate-passes/ordinary-path-otherwise form, and several repeat the same 'only if' sufficiency defect.

target_diversity.reason: Targets span ring, hub, access route, quality disposition, room, and review queue, with independent controls spanning duration, weekday, channel, cabinet, time, and vendor.

turn_rhythm_diversity.reason: e01 and e05 have the same 17-message rhythm and the same changed indices [3,6], control at [7,8], and procedural tail at [9:16]. e06 uses the same rule-evidence-neutral-acknowledgment-control-checklist-four-sections-status-labels sequence, while e02 is a modestly expanded version of that rhythm.

retained_tail_structure_diversity.reason: e01 and e05 are near-literal substitutions: evidence location, unresolved owner and next check, superseded note, four sections, change log, observed/pending/failed labels, and the exact closing sentence. e06 repeats nearly all of that scaffold, and e02 repeats the evidence-index/change-log/superseded-entry pattern. Only e03 and especially e04 supply materially different retained-tail structures.

author_and_session_diversity.reason: The packet reports three authoring sessions across two model families: one Codex session for e01-e02, a second Codex session for e03-e04, and one Claude Sonnet 5 session for e05-e06. This is some provenance diversity, but each session authored a pair and the Claude pair reproduces the dominant Codex scaffold rather than adding independent structure.

stylistic_diversity.reason: Across e01, e02, e05, and e06, repeated phrases include 'rule is deliberately simple,' 'independent of the ... decision,' 'Recorded as a separate control fact,' 'Use four short sections,' superseded-not-deleted advice, observed/pending/failed labels, and substantially identical neutral closing lines. Domain nouns change more than discourse style.

shared_fill_in_the_nouns_scaffold.reason: The set contains a shared fill-in-the-nouns scaffold. e01 and e05 are the clearest direct template pair, while e06 and, to a lesser degree, e02 extend the same template. Distinct domains and targets do not compensate for repeated turn function, sentence form, control placement, and retained-tail choreography.

cross_case_diversity_review.minimum_remediation: Replace at least e05 and e06 with independently structured conversations and non-procedural or differently procedural retained tails; vary where the control appears, whether the focal is explicit or probe-derived, the number and function of turns, and the discourse style. Recheck e01/e02 overlap after replacement rather than merely paraphrasing nouns and labels.

overall_verdict.reason: The packet set fails the mandatory target-aware and diversity gates: e06 is not literally sufficient for its targets, three unresolved-at-probe cases are incompatible with the shared resolved-decision carrier, and the cross-case set contains a rejected fill-in-the-nouns scaffold. This is an advisory review; Sol owns final adjudication.
